content.text:
**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position met) — no redline proposed.**

Section 20 of the Brightline agreement satisfies every preferred INDEMN element:

| Element | Where |
|---|---|
| Express duty to defend Customer + affiliates | § 20.1 ("defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents") |
| Third-party claims | § 20.1 / § 20.2 |
| IP infringement of Services/Deliverables | § 20.1 |
| Vendor's breach of Applicable Law | § 20.2 |
| Data breach caused by Vendor | § 20.2 ("unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor") |
| Gross negligence / wilful misconduct | § 20.2 (plus fraud) |
| Notice / control of defence / cooperation | § 20.4, with prejudice-limited notice standard and settlement-consent protection |
| Narrow Customer indemnity | § 20.3 — unmodified Customer-supplied material and Customer's violation of Applicable Law only, with Vendor Technology/modification/combination/instruction carve-outs |

Upside beyond the checklist: § 20.5 adds procure/modify/replace plus refund remedies with a bar on terminating unaffected Services, and § 21.3 treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims, so Vendor's indemnity is uncapped rather than subject to the fallback 3× annual-fee super-cap. Nothing here should be reopened.
